caption: Every enterprise runs legacy applications it can't switch off, because the data inside still matters.
Keeping them alive drains budget, widens the attack surface, and locks history in silos.
Solix Application Retirement moves structured and unstructured data into a governed Preservation Zone,
validates it against the source, then switches the old applications off for good.
Retention, legal hold, eDiscovery, and access and privacy controls apply from the day data lands.
You stay audit-ready, and records are defensibly deleted when retention ends.
And preserved data doesn't sit idle.
With Solix Data Ask, people ask in plain English and get cited answers,
grounded in the application's own Knowledge Graph.
Lower cost. Less risk. Governed history, ready for AI.
Retire, preserve, and activate, with Solix.
